purpose: Backend contract for the separate GUI agent; layout and presentation remain user decisions.

read.network_behavior: Reads SQLite and replays locally; never downloads or polls.

refresh.label: Elo game history
refresh.scope: 2002 through selected season, regular season and playoffs
refresh.behavior: Same source catalog, refresh-all loop and failure-preserving snapshot behavior as other datasets.

not_loaded.note: sources and warnings explain absence; do not display default 1500 or 50% as a substitute.

states.loaded: available=true. sources[0] includes fetched_at, source_updated_at, attempted_at, status, error, URL, row_count, context and warnings.
states.refresh_failed_with_cache: available=true and saved results retained; sources[0].status=refresh_failed and error describes failure. Preserve freshness/error visibility.
states.invalid_history: HTTP 422 with detail; do not fabricate ratings. HTTP 422 also rejects season outside 2002–2100.

joins.team: Canonical NFL codes, identical to matchups/rankings. Historical relocations map OAK->LV, STL->LA, SD->LAC.
joins.game: matchups[].game_id matches the nflverse game_id used by the matchup API.

team_fields.rating: Unrounded current rating for selected season
team_fields.rank: Higher is better; exact ties use 1,2,2,4 competition ranks
team_fields.season_start_rating: Rating after offseason regression and before the first selected-season result
team_fields.season_change: Current rating minus season-start rating; excludes offseason regression
team_fields.last_change: Most recent game adjustment, or null when no selected-season result exists
team_fields.games_played: Completed regular-season plus playoff games in selected season
team_fields.games: Chronological current-season logs, including opponent, side, rating_before, rating_after, change, expected_score, result (1/0.5/0), scores, kickoff, phase, week and complete home/away replay details

matchup_fields.basis: pregame_ratings for completed; latest_ratings for upcoming/awaiting_score
matchup_fields.home_advantage: 50 points for designated home team, 0 at a neutral site
matchup_fields.completed: home/away_rating_before, home/away_rating_after, home/away_change, home_result and margin_multiplier
matchup_fields.upcoming_or_awaiting_score: home_rating and away_rating are latest available ratings; scores are null; no invented result or rating change

other_fields.league: Mean, median, direction and number of teams. Team weights are equal.
other_fields.latest_result_kickoff: Kickoff of latest included result, NOT source fetch time or final whistle time
other_fields.replayed_games: All completed games from 2002 through selected season
other_fields.awaiting_score_game_ids: Started games without published scores, excluded from updates
other_fields.config: Approved K, home advantage and offseason retention

required_interpretation: Elo expected score: P(win) + 0.5 × P(tie). No separate tie model or spread-cover probability.
Label percentage as Elo expected score. It is neither a Kalshi quote nor a spread-cover probability.
Keep the nflverse final-status limitation and source timestamps/errors accessible.
Latest-rating expectations for future games do not simulate intervening games.
No GUI-side Elo calculation or margin application is needed; use backend values.
